title: app-engine app.json
description: Manifest for an app-engine / Atrium app. Place this file at the root of an app directory alongside index.html (or declare an entry_point backend). The authoritative validator is app_engine/manifest.py; this schema mirrors it for editor tooling.

id.description: Stable unique app id, independent of display name or path. Defaults to the folder name.

label.description: Human-readable display name shown in the launcher.

icon.description: Emoji or single character shown beside the label.

version.description: Semantic version (e.g. "1.2.0"). The major.minor.patch triple defines update ordering.

description.description: One- or two-line summary shown in the catalog.

categories.description: Taxonomy tags for grouping and search (e.g. ["games"], ["tools", "ai"]).

screenshots.description: Relative paths (inside the app dir) to preview images. No leading '/' or '..'.

min_engine_version.description: Minimum host engine version required. Apps requiring a newer engine are shown as incompatible rather than served broken.

permissions.description: Browser capabilities the app requests. Delegated to the iframe's allow (Permissions-Policy); the browser prompts for consent at point of use. Requires the sandbox to include allow-same-origin.

sandbox.description: iframe sandbox attribute. false disables the sandbox entirely (discouraged). Avoid combining allow-scripts with allow-same-origin on the single-origin engine.

entry_point.description: Backend URL to reverse-proxy /apps/{id}/... to. Omit for a pure static (index.html) app.

chat_enabled.description: Show the grounded local-AI tutor panel for this app.

chat_system_prompt.description: System prompt for the tutor when chat_enabled is true.

chat_knowledge.description: Relative path to a reviewed knowledge pack used to ground tutor answers.
